children: NetApp announced a planned fully managed, OCI-native NetApp ONTAP storage service with Oracle to help migrate and manage AI and enterprise workloads. General availability is planned within 12 months.
Signals deeper Oracle partnership and cloud expansion for NTAP’s data platform.
Aligns with spending growth areas; could lift cloud storage demand.
Managed via OCI Console and ONTAP APIs
Eases migration of existing ONTAP users to OCI, lowering friction.
Timeline guides expectations; revenue impact not near-term.
High-value, sticky customers; potential for higher-margin workloads.

This is an early-stage strategic extension of NetApp’s cloud-native footprint, partnering tightly with Oracle. For it to be a larger catalyst, watch for firm launch timing, customer wins, ARR contribution, and any exclusivity or revenue-sharing details.
